page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with Latin and Greek paragraphs. No marginal notes. A catchword in Greek sits at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: omnes[?], quamuis eiusdem fidei essent, easdem traditiones in Ecclesijs seruare. Et, ὡς τῆς αὐτῆς πίστεως πολλάκις ἢ τὰ ἐν διαφόρως καθισταμένοι[?]. Eandem colentes fidem saepenumero consuetudinum obseruatione inter se variare. Ipsi quoque qui ex Schismate sunt, Theophylactus Bulgariæ Archiepiscopus ad Nicolaum Diaconum; Οὐ πᾶν δόγμα ὑποχρίζειν τὰς Ἐκκλησίας ἰχνοῦ[?], ἀλλὰ τὸ ἐπὶς διαφορὰν ἄρον δόγματος[?]. Non omne dogma ad diuellendum Ecclesias valere, sed quod differentiam dogmatis facit. Neque diuersus ab his est Armeniorum Catholicus, vt colligi potest ex Legatione ad Armenios Theoriani, Ἀλλ' ὁ πολὺς ἐμοὶ λόγος ὡς τὴν ἑορτὴν ἐκ τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἐνδιαν[?], εἰ μόνον ὡς τὸ πίστιν ὁμοφωνήσωμεν. Verum non magnopere sollicitus quidem fuero de festis, aliisque consuetudinibus Ecclesiæ, modo sententijs de fide conueniamus. Hoc idem est, quod pluribus probat Demetrius Chomatenus in Responsionibus ad Constantinum Dyrrhachij Episcopum. Et ne reliquos recenseam, Auctor ipse Schismatis Photius Epistola ad Nicolaum Papam; Ἐξ ἂν οὐδὲ πίστεως ὡς ἐπ' ἀληθὲς μάχεσθαι[?]. ἀλλ' ἡγεῖ ἐν τοῖς κοινωνικοῖς πράγμασι, ἡ ἀκριβὲς μέτρον κοινωνίας τῶν ἐν τοῖς λοιποῖς ἃς ἐπὶ σκοπὸν τὴν, καὶ πολυσχεδὲς μὴ ἐνδιδόντος[?]. Ἐὰν γὰρ ὄντως κοινὰ πᾶσιν, ἃ παρὰ φυλάξειν ἐπαναλύσεις, καὶ ἐπέρῳ τῆς ἄλλων[?].

page.notes: Much of the Greek is faint or abraded and is transcribed as best as legible; words marked [?] are doubtful. The first Latin word reads as "cmnes" on the scan, which is most likely "omnes" printed with a worn o; it is marked [?]. Several Greek words in the lower half could not be read letter by letter and are approximate. The Latin is clear throughout. No running head is printed. The printed Greek catchword at the lower right is uncertain.
